name: HALF BENDING PUSHING FORWARD
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your knees slightly bent. Lean your upper body forward, with your arms bent and parallel to your body.\n\nPush and stretch your arms forward in line with your upper body. Then return and repeat.

tips.text: Keep your arms in line with your upper body when you push them forward.
It’s a good exercise for your deltoids.
